package.name: deploy_mjpc
package.description: MJPC lower-body balance controller for the Unitree H1-2: the fork's own CLI controller (badinkajink/mujoco_mpc@extended_hw mjpc/deploy/h12_lower_body_controller.cc + deploy_common.cc, compiled straight from the submodule) driving the 12 leg joints through the safety layer's split LOWER channel, run behind a rclpy param launcher (rclcpp and unitree_sdk2 CycloneDDS builds must not share a process), plus the fork's RW-EKF proprioceptive base estimator behind a rclpy param shell.
